english.title: Conduct / cause / knowingly permit activity in contravention of an environmental permit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[operated a regulated facility,]_
(B)_[caused a water discharge activity,]_
(C)_[caused a groundwater activity,]_
(D)_[knowingly permitted a water discharge activity,]_
(E)_[knowingly permitted a groundwater activity,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY FACILITY OR ACTIVITY ..), other than under and to the extent authorised by an environmental permit
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(1), 38(1)(a) and 39(1) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and Location
operated a regulated facility
caused or knowingly permitted a water discharge activity or groundwater activity
not under or to the extent authorised by an environmental permit

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The offence does not apply if the water discharge activity or groundwater activity is an exempt facility.
(ii) In respect of radioactive substances activity, the offence does not apply to a person to whom a radioactive substances exemption applies for that activity.
(iii) See also regulations 12(4) and (5) for further information.
